statements.notes:
PURE CREATINE MONOHYDRATE
SUPPORT MUSCLE RECOVERY**
IMPROVE ENDURANCE**
INCREASE MUSCLE STRENGTH**
BUILDING ATHLETES FROM THE INSIDE OUT(TM)

The body can only store small amounts of ATP, the limiting factor of muscle contractions. Supplemental CREATINE helps super-saturate muscle tissues with phospho CREATINE. This substantially increases ATP activation yielding greater explosive power output, faster between-set energy repletion, and increased training intensity.**
Creapure(R) is a licensed registered trademark of AlzChem Trostberg GmbH.
**These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.

(molecular picture)
CREATINE is the body’s natural Power Reservoir that makes short-burst, explosive muscle contractions possible. Whether produced in the body or consumed as a supplement, CREATINE is transported into muscle tissues where it is stored as phosphocreatine.**
Phosphocreatine activates ATP (Adenosine Triphosphate) molecules – the intracellular “energy mechanisms” that fuel powerful muscle contractions.**
*MANUFACTURED FREE OF BANNED SUBSTANCES IN A NSF GMP FOR SPORT(TM) REGISTERED FACILITY

DIRECTIONS and USE
Use as a dietary supplement, use 1-3 servings (5g/serving). Mix with water or beverage of your choice. 
CytoSport products complement a healthful eating and hydration plan that, when combined with a balanced exercise program may contribute to healthy weight management and recovery from exercise. Use as part of a well balanced diet. 
When taking any creatine supplement it is important to stay hydrated. Drink 128 fl-oz of water daily to ensure adequate hydration. 
Do not use this product as your sole source of nutrition.
(picture of glass and scoop)
CREATINE FUELS ATP ACTIVATION FOR EXPLOSIVE MUSCLE STRENGTH**

*Our products are manufactured in compliance with NSF International’s GMP for Sport(TM) Registration, including semi-annual audits, verifying that no NSF 306-Certification Guideline Annex A List banned substances exist in our facility.

CYTOSPORT CREATINE MONOHYDRATE is 100% pure Creapure(R) Creatine Monohydrate. Creapure(R) is produced in Germany under the strictest of manufacturing guidelines that result in a product guaranteed to be highest in quality, purity and safety. No fillers or fluff – this product is just pure maximum performance CREATINE Monohydrate.
